name: Luxury hero: split marble portrait, gold hairlines, italic serif
notes: Original build for the library, not adapted from a client site — restraint is the whole design: one accent (gold), one weight of hairline (1px), generous whitespace instead of visual noise. Ring-monogram + tracked wordmark reads as a badge/seal rather than a logo lockup — reuse that device for other high-end sections (real estate, private practice, bespoke goods, weddings) rather than the botanical/floral device already used for the softer 'elegant' family (0004/0005). Footnote row (Est./By Referral/Rating) is a credibility device that works instead of a stat row when the brand's positioning is scarcity/exclusivity rather than scale.
